race.comment: MONGOLIAN MASTER (1) is a four-year-old gelding who is having his first run for the David Hatch yard after making the move from Vic. Has shown enough in his first two starts to suggest he can kick things off with a win in the new colours. MINERS MATE (7) was well fancied last time out on the back of a strong run fresh but was no match for a tearaway pair at Bathurst. Still tried hard to grab third and is worth following up in this suitable contest. SUVATHI (6) hasn't raced for 645 days and while she'll likely need the run her lead-up trial was good and this isn't a deep contest. Have to include. MALAY PENINSULA (5) is a Tiger Of Malay gelding on debut for the Singleton yard. Has shown enough in his two trials to suggest he can make his presence felt.
